system.description:
CR 1 Strange Check to shapeshift into an uncanny copy of a person or object; exceeding the CR makes the copy more convincing. Under stress or duress, a Strange Check (CR set by the stress) keeps the form; on a failure you revert.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.65
system.summary: CR 1 Strange Check to shapeshift into an uncanny copy of a person or object; exceeding the CR makes the copy more convincing. Under stress or duress, a Strange Check (CR set by the stress) keeps the form; on a failure you revert.

automation.label: Shapeshift
automation.onSuccess: You take the chosen form; each success above CR 1 makes it more convincing.

automation.label: Hold the form under stress or duress (CR by the stress)
automation.onFail: You revert to your normal form.
